action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let exposureSlider = null; sliders.forEach(s => { if (s.previousElementSibling && s.previousElementSibling.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('exposure')) exposureSlider = s; if (s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('exposure')) exposureSlider = exposureSlider || s; }); if (!exposureSlider) { sliders.forEach(s => { if (parseFloat(s.min) === 0 && parseFloat(s.max) === 1 && parseFloat(s.step) === 0.01 && parseFloat(s.value) === 0.3) exposureSlider = s; }); } if (exposureSlider) { exposureSlider.value = 0.7; exposureSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let decaySlider = null; sliders.forEach(s => { if (s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('decay')) decaySlider = s; }); if (!decaySlider) { sliders.forEach(s => { if (parseFloat(s.min) >= 0.8 && parseFloat(s.max) <= 1.0 && parseFloat(s.value) === 0.96) decaySlider = s; }); } if (decaySlider) { decaySlider.value = 0.9; decaySlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

window.__PRE_LIGHT_POS__ = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__3D_STATE__.lightPosition)); const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let angleSlider = null; sliders.forEach(s => { if (s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().match(/orbit|angle/i)) angleSlider = s; }); if (!angleSlider) { sliders.forEach(s => { if (parseFloat(s.max) === 360) angleSlider = s; }); } if (angleSlider) { angleSlider.value = 180; angleSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }
const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button'); let raysBtn = null; buttons.forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('rays')) raysBtn = b; }); if (raysBtn) raysBtn.click();
const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button'); let raysBtn = null; buttons.forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('rays')) raysBtn = b; }); if (raysBtn) raysBtn.click();

const selects = document.querySelectorAll('select'); let blendSelect = null; selects.forEach(s => { s.querySelectorAll('option').forEach(o => { if (o.textContent.includes('Screen')) blendSelect = s; }); }); if (blendSelect) { blendSelect.value = 'Screen'; blendSelect.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); blendSelect.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let samplesSlider = null; sliders.forEach(s => { if (s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('sample')) samplesSlider = s; }); if (!samplesSlider) { sliders.forEach(s => { if (parseInt(s.max) === 150 && parseInt(s.value) === 80) samplesSlider = s; }); } if (samplesSlider) { samplesSlider.value = 40; samplesSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

window.__PRE_HEIGHT__ = window.__3D_STATE__.lightHeight; const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let heightSlider = null; sliders.forEach(s => { if (s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('height')) heightSlider = s; }); if (!heightSlider) { sliders.forEach(s => { if (parseFloat(s.min) === 0.5 && parseFloat(s.max) === 6.0) heightSlider = s; }); } if (heightSlider) { heightSlider.value = 5.5; heightSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }
